A saved written entry in the notes area of the app.
Carrying unfinished work forward to the next period.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports pop-up tools
sections.what: Brings in React state, icons, the store and the confetti effect.
sections.why: Likely reason: needed for the two-step pop-up, the store updates and the celebration effect.

sections.name: DailyReviewModalProps
sections.title: Pop-up inputs
sections.what: Declares that the pop-up receives an open flag and a close function from its parent.
sections.why: Likely reason: the parent decides when the pop-up is visible.

sections.name: DailyReviewModal (part 1)
sections.title: Finish action and today's task counts
sections.what: Remembers the star rating, the typed reflection and the current step. Counts today's tasks as completed or unfinished, and shows nothing while closed. The finish action runs the confetti, adds experience points, saves the journal note if there is text, moves unfinished tasks to upcoming, and closes.
sections.why: Likely reason: the finish action bundles the whole shutdown routine into one click.
sections.watch_out: Experience points are added on every finish, with no check that the review was not already done.

sections.name: DailyReviewModal (part 2)
sections.title: Summary step screen
sections.what: Shows the completed and unfinished task counts and a list of tasks that will roll over. A button moves the user to the second step.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user see what will carry over before finishing.
sections.watch_out: The list says tasks will roll over, but the actual move happens only when the review is completed.

sections.name: DailyReviewModal (part 3)
sections.title: Rating and reflection step
sections.what: Shows five stars for rating the day, a text box for reflection, and the button that completes the review.
sections.why: Likely reason: captures how the day went and what comes next before closing the routine. Reason for five stars not stated.
sections.watch_out: Stars and text are not cleared after closing, so the next opening may show the previous answers.

summary: An evening pop-up that summarizes today's tasks, asks for a rating and reflection, moves unfinished tasks to upcoming, and awards experience points.
purpose: Helps the user close the day and carry unfinished work forward.
why: Likely reason: a daily shutdown routine that rewards the user and saves a journal entry. Reason for the reward amount not stated.
how: When open, shows step one with counts of completed and unfinished tasks for today, and lists the unfinished ones. The next button leads to step two, which asks for a one to five star rating and a reflection. Completing the review shows a confetti effect, awards 150 experience points, saves the reflection as a journal note if any text was written, moves unfinished tasks to upcoming, and closes.
inputs: Tasks from the store, plus the open flag and close function from the parent. The stars and reflection text the user enters.
outputs: Experience points, a journal note, tasks changed to upcoming, and a closed pop-up. Closing early saves nothing.
risks: Experience points are awarded every time the review is completed, with no check against repeats on the same day. The pop-up keeps its step and text after closing, so reopening may show the old second step. Unfinished tasks move even if the user did not read the list.
debug: If experience points jump, check whether the review was completed more than once. If the journal note is missing, check that reflection text was entered. If unfinished tasks did not move, check the update function and their status values. If the pop-up opens on the wrong step, that is the state issue described above.
